notes.title: DEMO Update
notes.notes:
[b]Hello everyone!
[/b]
We've been incredibly lucky to receive valuable feedback from streamers, playtesters, and players like you. Thanks to your insights, we've been able to identify bugs and areas where our game design wasn’t as clear as we thought. We've made lots of improvements!

This latest demo update includes many visual and technical fixes, as well as new mechanics, like using tools such as the axe and fire extinguisher.

This will likely be the final version of the demo before we launch the full game in a few months. The full version will feature:
- 4 to 5 hours of gameplay
- 30+ handcrafted levels
- New biomes, tools, mechanics, and dialogs to explore

As always, thank you so much for your support, your feedback, and your time. It means a lot to us.

Have a great day!
And feel free to whisilist the game, if you might be interested in it. It helps us a lot.

Florian
